title: Truth of the Sacrifice
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji finally saw the true cost of the Heavenly Fate Lock, he found himself standing at a crossroads from which there was no return—and Chen Nian on the altar was shaking her head at him with her last vestiges of consciousness.

text.content: The moment that black light tore through the sky, Chen Ji's footsteps halted abruptly. In the heavens above a hundred li, seventeen Nascent Soul auras closed in on him like starving wolves—the Holy Sect's distress signal came faster and more deadly than he'd anticipated. Among those auras, at least three had reached late Nascent Soul stage, sufficient to crush this Foundation Building cultivator into dust. He didn't look back; instead, he pushed his escape light to its limit, darting toward the core of the sacrifice. His Heavenly Fate Value was merely thirty-seven points remaining, and the ritual's completion was at most a quarter hour away.

A blood-colored altar stood above the abyss, with nine black iron chains descending from the void, shrouding a thousand zhang in thick demonic energy. Those chains were inscribed with eerie runes, emanating a nauseating scent of blood. Chen Ji concealed himself in the shadows, his gaze sharp as a blade cutting through layers of mist—at the altar's center, a slender figure hung suspended in mid-air, surrounded by strange golden runes. As golden light flickered, he clearly saw that person's face—a gaunt, pale visage.

Chen Nian. His sister, taken by the Holy Sect as the key to Heavenly Fate. Eleven years of searching, eleven years of scheming, countless brushes with death—all for this moment. He remembered she was only seven when they took her, hiding behind their mother, watching those black-robed figures drag her away with fearful eyes. He remembered himself kneeling at the sect gate for three days and nights, begging them to send help, only to receive the words 'Such is her fate.'

dialogue.content: "Brother... brother..." Chen Nian's voice was faint as a mosquito's whine, yet it pierced Chen Ji's heart like ten thousand arrows. Her voice was hoarse and frail, as if it might dissolve into the wind at any moment: "Don't... don't worry about me... run..." Her lips trembled slightly, as if using every ounce of strength to prevent him from approaching, tears glistening at the corners of her eyes.

text.content: "Don't worry about her?" A cold, fierce curve formed on Chen Ji's lips, yet beneath his eyes surged boundless killing intent. Eleven years—eleven years he'd searched for her, from worthless servant to mastermind of the world. Every move he'd made, every scheme, wasn't it all for this very moment? He learned patience, learned disguise, learned to play the role of a cowardly weakling before everyone—merely to one day possess sufficient strength to wrest her back from these people's hands.

Just then, the Tianji Record patterns on his right hand blazed brilliantly—the fourth page was awakening! Golden characters flooded into his Mental Sea like a tide, presenting a clear vision: nine black iron chains, each connected to the foundation of a sealing formation. Only by simultaneously destroying all nine anchor points could the ritual be interrupted. And each anchor point concealed restrictions sufficient to kill a Nascent Soul cultivator. The Tianji Record provided the method, but also the warning—if he failed, both spirit and soul would be utterly destroyed.

choice.prompt: Nine anchor points, seventeen Nascent Soul auras, a quarter hour—Chen Ji, what is your choice?

choices.description: Simultaneously destroy all nine anchor points at maximum speed—highest risk but saves time

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his True Qi surging madly within. Sword light pierced the air, transforming into nine fierce sword energies that struck directly at the nine black iron chains! The Holy Sect Elder's restrictions were instantly triggered, backlash force surging toward him like a tide—but in his eyes, there was only that slender figure on the altar.

choices.text: Stealthily Strike Down One by One
choices.description: Infiltrate and destroy anchor points—high safety but excessive time consumption
choices.risk_hint: Ritual may be impossible to interrupt before completion

text.content: Chen Ji收敛气息，化作一道暗影穿梭于祭坛周围。他找到一个隐蔽的角落，指尖凝聚出一道细如发丝的剑气，悄无声息地刺入第一道锚点——然而，就在锚点崩碎的瞬间，祭坛上的符文suddenly加速运转！

choices.description: Consume Heavenly Fate Value to foresee anchor point weaknesses, greatly increasing success rate
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value is already running low
